notes.title: Inspired by the classic SimTower, build up high with Property Pro
notes.content:
Property Pro is an upcoming game from SimDevs, with an aim to capture the classic feel of SimTower from the 90s.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2023/02/inspired-by-the-classic-simtower-build-up-high-with-property-pro
